resources.string: Adapter not found. Check USB power and cable, then retry.
Choose the USB adapter to use. The saved adapter is unavailable or cannot be identified uniquely.
USB permission is needed. Tap Request USB access to try again.
The adapter could not open. Check whether another app is using it.
A USB write failed. Check the cable and adapter power.
The adapter sent an incomplete or corrupt packet. Reconnect the adapter.
The adapter did not respond in time. Check USB power and retry.
The phone or picture did not become ready. Choose a phone in Tools or try connecting again.
The USB adapter disconnected. Reconnect its cable.
The native projection engine could not start. Stop the session and retry.
The connection stopped unexpectedly. Open diagnostics before retrying.
Remembering requires a unique serial number exposed by Android after USB permission. Otherwise choose it each time.
Recovery, driver presentation, audio and local session history.
USB adapter: phone selection, resolution, frame rate, Cabin audio gains and live diagnostics are supported. Bluetooth audio transfer bypasses Cabin gains.
Native engine: use the native video and phone controls above. USB recovery, Cabin audio gains and USB pipeline counters are unavailable for this backend.
Hide the projection control strip after
Audio continues. Interaction resets the timer; the wake gesture is kept on this screen.
I am parked and ready to preview
Keep this picture? Reverting in %1$d seconds.
Return to projection to confirm a visible picture. Without confirmation the previous settings return.
Playback uses Bluetooth transfer. Cabin does not own the output; Cabin gain controls are unavailable.
Cabin owns adapter PCM playback. Calls, assistants and alerts keep their own routes.
Applies at the next session. Responsive uses less latency; resilient absorbs more jitter with a larger delay.
Save up to eight named media/navigation gain presets. Applying a preset leaves call and assistant routing intact.
Uses Android-exposed inputs and supported mono voice formats. Changes apply to the next capture session; Android can choose a fallback.
The preferred input was unavailable. Android selected the fallback input.
Android has not granted playback focus, so Cabin is silent. Retry only affects a still-requested stream; it cannot override an active focus loss.
Counters refresh once per second. No PCM, projection content or media metadata is retained.
Opt-in only: up to 100 durations, reason codes and recovery times. No phone identifiers or media metadata. Turning this off deletes the history.
Drag around the edges without lifting. Unexpected cancellations and missing pointers are counted locally; this does not calibrate Android.
Video settings could not be saved or restored. Retry Revert; the recovery record is kept for the next launch.
